svg.title: Communication — live answers and ordinary API requests
svg.desc: Follow the numbered connectors. Subnumbers identify branches or smaller steps. Optional actions and supporting relationships are labeled separately. The browser uses a live WebSocket connection for chat and HTTP APIs for schema information and other supported requests. The app checks requests and sends progress, SQL, assistant text, and a final response. Invalid requests, lost connections, or timeouts are surfaced as errors. Both hosting adapters share the live-request behavior.
